notes: SR44 Bed Bath & Beyond (bedbathandbeyond.com, Beyond Inc./Overstock platform). Access: homepage/robots.txt direct 200; /c/ and /results.html paths Akamai 403 direct; translate.goog proxy used to read origin HTML where needed. INVESTIGATION: found a page-type constant 'clearance:4471' in homepage JS config alongside 'guides'/'flashdeals', prompting a direct look. /clearance HTTP-301-redirects to the site's own /Clearance,/clearance,/results.html (a 'Guided Nav' results page hosted on bedbathandbeyond.com itself, pageContext pageName/pageType literally 'Clearance', SEO title 'Clearance | Discover our Best Deals at Bed Bath & Beyond'). Fetched via translate.goog (direct fetch of the results.html path was Akamai 403): resultCount:1114 and JSON-LD numberOfItems:1114 agree, and the JSON-LD itemListElement entries resolve to real bedbathandbeyond.com-hosted PDPs (e.g. 'Surya Adhira Indoor/Outdoor Farmhouse Area Rug' -> bedbathandbeyond.com/Home-Garden/.../product.html) with AggregateOffer pricing -- confirmed genuine own-site product listing, not a marketing page. SEPARATELY there is a promotional '/deals/clearance' landing hub (pageType/pageName also 'Clearance', title 'The Best Deals Online') that contains ZERO bedbathandbeyond.com-hosted product tiles itself -- every one of its department-level 'Clearance' tiles (Furniture, Home Decor, Kitchen & Dining, Rugs, Lighting, Electronics, etc.) links OUT to www.overstock.com (a sibling Beyond Inc. brand, different domain/storefront), e.g. https://www.overstock.com/search?taxonomy=dep3&moreclearance=Clearance&TID=Clearance:HomeDecor. Those overstock.com listings were explicitly NOT extracted -- they are not hosted on bedbathandbeyond.com, consistent with this project scoping each company to its own assigned site (matches the prior Home-Decor pass's finding of a Beyond-Inc-wide cross-brand bar to containerstore.com, i.e. cross-brand referral rather than this site's own catalogue). SALE VS CLEARANCE: also checked '/deals' (generic promotional 'Best Deals' hub) and 'On-Sale,/sale,/results.html' (promotion=on+sale facet used site-wide, e.g. /c/furniture?...&promotion=on+sale) -- both are generic temporary/rotating discount facets with no permanence signal and were correctly excluded per the Sale-vs-Clearance test; only the dedicated /clearance results page carries the site's own explicit 'Clearance' page-type/label. No local-language variants applicable (USA/English site).

Canonical short entry point https://www.bedbathandbeyond.com/clearance 301-redirects to this URL.
